opening: The swelling and pain in my right knee have gotten worse recently.
The pain makes it hard for me to walk.
The pain makes it hard to do my daily activities.
I was diagnosed with arthritis 16 years ago.

opening.text: My right knee is swollen and it hurts. The swelling and pain have gotten worse recently, which makes it hard for me to walk or do my daily activities. I was diagnosed with arthritis 16 years ago.
